source_archive.restore: overlay onto the recorded git base; install local dependencies separately

freeze.selection_criterion: smallest equal-weight mean placement across scripted/round_robin and heuristic/shuffled_rounds; full completion required; exact ties prefer fewer optional controllers
freeze.prohibition: No training or model/runtime selection after final results; preserve all failures.
freeze.measurement_context: Three scenario processes run concurrently on this Mac; decision latency is not isolated or online latency.

metrics.confidence_interval_scope: The interval estimates complete_block_mean_placement using whole eight-seat blocks; mean_placement uses every normally completed game and can have a different denominator. mean_placement_seed_bootstrap_95ci is retained as a legacy alias.
